### R Code

Each script reproduces every output printed on the matching slides. `Class3.R`,
`Class4.R` and `Class6.R` read the data files listed below by relative paths, so run
them from the folder that contains `data/`; `Class6.R` writes its figures to a
`Figures/` folder it creates. `Class5.R` needs no data file.

- [Lecture 3 - `Class3.R`](https://github.com/mauricioromero86/mauricioromero86.github.io/releases/download/teaching-archive/AnalisisEmpirico_202602_Class3.R)
- [Lecture 4 - `Class4.R`](https://github.com/mauricioromero86/mauricioromero86.github.io/releases/download/teaching-archive/AnalisisEmpirico_202602_Class4.R)
- [Lecture 5 - `Class5.R`](https://github.com/mauricioromero86/mauricioromero86.github.io/releases/download/teaching-archive/AnalisisEmpirico_202602_Class5.R)
- [Lecture 6 - `Class6.R`](https://github.com/mauricioromero86/mauricioromero86.github.io/releases/download/teaching-archive/AnalisisEmpirico_202602_Class6.R)

### Practice sessions {#practice-session}

Three guided 90-minute practices use the **one-year Partnership Schools for Liberia
evaluation** to build an analysis dataset, reproduce figures, and fit published
models. A separate 45-minute GIS extension maps county coverage. These are
standalone, ungraded practices outside the numbered lectures; no homework is attached.

**[Download the complete AER workshop (.zip)](https://github.com/mauricioromero86/mauricioromero86.github.io/releases/download/teaching-archive/AnalisisEmpirico_202602_Class4B_Liberia_PSL_AER.zip)** — all four scripts and slide decks,
data, the student guide, recovery files and reference outputs (12.3 MB).

Extract the whole ZIP and open **Class4B_AER.Rproj**. Install tidyverse and haven
before starting; the GIS extension also needs sf. Run short chunks alongside
the instructor, then adapt the code during the exercises. Everything runs offline
after package installation. The separate scripts below use the data included in the ZIP.

| Practice | Prerequisites | Time | Materials |
|---|---|---:|---|
| A · Build the dataset | Importing, cleaning and joins | 90 min | [Slides](https://github.com/mauricioromero86/mauricioromero86.github.io/releases/download/teaching-archive/AnalisisEmpirico_202602_Lecture04B_Liberia_PSL_AER.pdf) · [R script](https://github.com/mauricioromero86/mauricioromero86.github.io/releases/download/teaching-archive/AnalisisEmpirico_202602_Class4B_AER.R) |
| B · Reproduce figures | Visualization | 90 min | [Slides](https://github.com/mauricioromero86/mauricioromero86.github.io/releases/download/teaching-archive/AnalisisEmpirico_202602_Lecture04B_Liberia_PSL_AER_Figures.pdf) · [R script](https://github.com/mauricioromero86/mauricioromero86.github.io/releases/download/teaching-archive/AnalisisEmpirico_202602_Class4B_AER_Figures.R) |
| C · Models and randomization inference | Programming and experiments | 90 min | [Slides](https://github.com/mauricioromero86/mauricioromero86.github.io/releases/download/teaching-archive/AnalisisEmpirico_202602_Lecture04B_Liberia_PSL_AER_RI.pdf) · [R script](https://github.com/mauricioromero86/mauricioromero86.github.io/releases/download/teaching-archive/AnalisisEmpirico_202602_Class4B_AER_RI.R) |
| GIS · Map county coverage | Spatial data | 45 min | [Slides](https://github.com/mauricioromero86/mauricioromero86.github.io/releases/download/teaching-archive/AnalisisEmpirico_202602_Lecture04B_Liberia_PSL_AER_GIS.pdf) · [R script](https://github.com/mauricioromero86/mauricioromero86.github.io/releases/download/teaching-archive/AnalisisEmpirico_202602_Class4B_AER_GIS.R) |

Study: Romero, Sandefur and Sandholtz (2020),
[*American Economic Review* 110(2)](https://doi.org/10.1257/aer.20181478).
I am a coauthor of the study. The [AER replication package](https://doi.org/10.7910/DVN/5OPIYU)
is licensed CC0 1.0. The county boundaries retain their separate
[CC BY-NC-SA 3.0 US license](https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-nc-sa/3.0/us/);
source details and license notices are included in the workshop.

### Data

The running example for the course. Neither analysis file sits ready-made on a portal:
both were cut from the national releases by the build script, so you can rebuild either one.

- [`municipios_clean.csv`](https://github.com/mauricioromero86/mauricioromero86.github.io/releases/download/teaching-archive/AnalisisEmpirico_202602_municipios_clean.csv) — 2,469 municipios: population, schooling, illiteracy, poverty rates
- [`enigh_hogares_raw.csv`](https://github.com/mauricioromero86/mauricioromero86.github.io/releases/download/teaching-archive/AnalisisEmpirico_202602_enigh_hogares_raw.csv) — 91,414 households: income, household size, state, survey weight
- [`coneval_pobreza.csv`](https://github.com/mauricioromero86/mauricioromero86.github.io/releases/download/teaching-archive/AnalisisEmpirico_202602_coneval_pobreza.csv) — CONEVAL poverty indicators, for the join exercises
- [`build_data_real.R`](https://github.com/mauricioromero86/mauricioromero86.github.io/releases/download/teaching-archive/AnalisisEmpirico_202602_build_data_real.R) — the script that produces all three
- [`coneval_municipal_2020_raw.csv`](https://github.com/mauricioromero86/mauricioromero86.github.io/releases/download/teaching-archive/AnalisisEmpirico_202602_coneval_municipal_2020_raw.csv) — 2,469 × 37, the CONEVAL release **uncleaned**: this is the file Lecture 4 cleans on screen
- [Read me first](https://github.com/mauricioromero86/mauricioromero86.github.io/releases/download/teaching-archive/AnalisisEmpirico_202602_data_README.md) — provenance, attribution, and what to read before you compute anything

Sources: INEGI, [Censo de Población y Vivienda 2020](https://www.inegi.org.mx/programas/ccpv/2020/) ·
INEGI, [ENIGH 2024](https://www.inegi.org.mx/programas/enigh/nc/2024/) ·
CONEVAL, [Medición de la pobreza municipal 2020](https://www.coneval.org.mx/Medicion/Paginas/Pobreza-municipio-2010-2020.aspx).
Accessed 2026-08-16. Nothing in these files is simulated or imputed.
